full_prompt_en: A square, finely rendered oil painting shows a gathering of riders and well-dressed onlookers along a pale dirt lane beside a wooden building. Dense dark green trees fill the upper left and recede behind a fence, making a shaded canopy over the crowd. At the right, a high timber wall and open porch rise out of the lane, their brown boards catching narrow warm highlights. Two brown horses stand in the left foreground, viewed mostly from behind and side, their glossy flanks and dark legs sharply modeled against the dusty ground. A rider in dark clothing sits on the nearer horse, while another figure in a bright brick-red coat adds a warm accent amid the animal forms. Across the center, a compact row of people in black, cream, and deep green coats talks and watches. Several wear pale straw hats with dark bands; others have taller dark hats. A man in a white suit stands near the right side, his back partly turned, becoming one of the brightest shapes against the shaded building. A second light-clothed figure and several dark-suited figures fill the narrow gaps around him. The group occupies the middle ground, leaving a broad clear patch of sunlit lane across the bottom. Tiny plants and irregular marks border this open foreground. The paint distinguishes polished horse coats, dusty earth, rough timber, and leafy shadow without losing a unified naturalistic surface. Sunlight filters from the left, touching hats, pale coats, and the horses' backs while the porch and upper foliage remain deep and cool. The overall composition balances a dense social band beneath the trees with the open light-colored ground, using a restrained earth palette and small bright accents to guide the eye.
full_prompt_zh: 这幅方形、精细描绘的油画表现骑手与着装考究的观众，沿着木屋旁的浅色土路聚集。浓密深绿树木占据左上并退向围栏后方，在人群上形成阴凉树冠。右侧，高木墙和敞开的门廊从路边升起，褐色木板接住狭窄暖光。两匹棕马站在左侧前景，多从后方和侧面可见，发亮的躯干与深色腿部在尘土地上塑形清楚。一名穿深衣的骑手坐在近处马背上，另一位穿鲜明砖红外套的人在马群间增添暖色点。中央一排紧凑的人穿黑、奶油和深绿外套，交谈并张望。多人戴有深色帽带的浅草帽，也有人戴较高的深色帽。右侧附近一名穿白色套装的男子部分背向观者，在阴影木屋前成为最明亮形体之一。另一名浅衣人物与数名深西装人物填满他周围的狭小空隙。人群占据中景，底部留下宽阔、受日光照亮的空土路。微小植物和不规则痕迹围住这片开放前景。颜料区分光滑马毛、尘土、粗木板与树荫，同时保持统一的自然主义表面。阳光从左侧穿入，触及帽子、浅色外套与马背，门廊和上方枝叶则保持深冷。整体构图以树下密集的社交人群平衡敞开浅色地面，借克制土地色域和少数亮色点引导目光。
style_prompt_en: The image has a finely modeled naturalistic oil surface, with controlled contours, layered dark foliage, and precise accents on reflective and rough materials. Olive, umber, dusty tan, cream, and near black dominate, with small warmer colors punctuating the subdued range. Forms overlap densely in a horizontal middle band, while a quieter light plane below gives them room and emphasizes their shadows. Sunlight is directional but filtered, catching upper surfaces in compact warm highlights and leaving sheltered recesses deep green-brown. Edges stay clear around the nearest forms and soften in crowded distance and leafy texture. The overall effect is orderly and observational, joining detailed small forms into a single calm light-dark structure.
style_prompt_zh: 图像有细致塑形的自然主义油画表面，轮廓受控，深色枝叶层叠，反光与粗糙材质上有精确重音。橄榄、赭褐、尘土棕、奶油与近黑色占主导，少量更暖色点穿插在克制色域中。形体在横向中部密集叠压，下方较安静的浅色平面给它们留出空间并强调阴影。阳光有方向却经过过滤，以紧凑暖高光照亮上表面，让遮蔽凹处保留深绿褐色。近处形体边缘清楚，在拥挤远处和树叶肌理里柔化。整体效果有序而重观察，把细致小形体结合为单一平静的明暗结构。
theme_en: A gathering of riders and well-dressed onlookers beside a wooden building
theme_zh: 骑手与着装考究的观众聚集在木屋旁
name: Jacques-Laurent Agasse
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
